test_policy.notes: Test-optional for students entering in fall 2027: SAT or ACT is not required for admission, and applicants can ask Elon to suppress scores already sent. Exceptions: applicants to the direct-admit BSN nursing program must submit scores (minimum SAT 1100 or ACT 22 to be eligible) and home-schooled applicants must submit scores. International applicants may apply without SAT/ACT if they spent at least three years of high school outside the U.S.; scores can still be sent for merit scholarship consideration. Self-reported scores are accepted; official scores are required before enrolling.

requirements.supplemental_essays: No separate supplement listed; the application essay is the second most important factor after the academic record.
requirements.notes: Apply with the Elon application or the Common App; required items are the application with the nonrefundable $60 fee, an official high school transcript and the School Report (included in the application). Teacher recommendations are not required but may be submitted. An InitialView interview is optional; if taken, applicants are invited to provide it and it is part of the file. The application page says about 19,000 applications for roughly 1,600 first-year seats. International applicants who do not attend a school taught in English must send TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo scores; passport, Certificate of Financial Responsibility and a bank statement are needed only after admission for the I-20. Honors and Fellows programs have a separate Nov. 10 application (apply to Elon by Nov. 1), and the PA/PT accelerated pathways Nov. 10; Honors, Fellows and Scholars add supplementary applications and interviews. The Dates & Deadlines page lists Early Decision II (Jan. 15) and Spring first-year (Dec. 1) but still carries 2026 notification dates, so those two are not entered as 2026-27 deadlines. No separate international deadline is published.

deadlines.label: Early Decision (binding)
deadlines.notes: Notified Dec. 1; non-refundable $1,000 enrollment deposit due Jan. 10. The apply page, which states it is for students enrolling in fall 2027, prints the date without a year.

deadlines.label: Early Action (non-binding)
deadlines.notes: Notified Dec. 20; enrollment deposit due May 1. The page prints the date without a year.

deadlines.label: Regular Deadline
deadlines.notes: Notified March 20; deposit due May 1. Applications after this date are considered on a space-available basis. The page prints the date without a year.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required if the applicant attends a school where English is not the primary language of instruction; TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo English Test. The international pages list no other waiver and do not accept SAT/ACT in place of English tests.

english.notes: Old 0-120 scale, exams taken before Jan. 21, 2026.
New 1-6 scale, exams taken on or after Jan. 21, 2026 (page: minimum 4).

aid.notes: "Elon is not able to offer need-based financial aid for non-U.S. citizens currently. We also do not offer full scholarships." All first-year applicants are considered for the Presidential Scholarship, Elon Engagement Scholarship and International Scholar Award; the Fellows and Scholars programs need a supplementary application and interview. Merit awards for international applicants range from $3,000 to $23,500 per year. U.S. citizens living abroad can apply for aid with the FAFSA and CSS Profile. After admission, F-1 applicants file a Certificate of Financial Responsibility with a bank statement dated within six months.

majors.notes: Elon describes the BSN as a highly competitive direct-admit program; applicants must submit SAT or ACT scores with a minimum SAT 1100 or ACT 22 to be eligible.

toefl.note: From the international requirements page ("The Elon TOEFL code is 5183"). SAT and ACT codes were not found on the Elon pages opened.

tier_notes.general: Mid-size private university with a 63% admit rate and a median SAT near 1270 among the 23% who submit. Placed level with Pepperdine (C) and below Santa Clara (B).
tier_notes.computer_science: Computer and information sciences are 2.5% of degrees in the Common Data Set.
tier_notes.engineering: Engineering is 1.3% of degrees in the Common Data Set.
tier_notes.math_physics: Mathematics/statistics and physical sciences together are about 2.3% of degrees (Common Data Set J1).
tier_notes.humanities: English, history, philosophy and languages together are about 3.7% of degrees (Common Data Set J1).
tier_notes.arts_design: Visual and performing arts are 5.2% of degrees; held at the general tier.
